title: Gemma 4 12B MTP drafter GGUF on M4 Max: parallel streams give ~50.6 tok/s (coding/general 2K in/out)
summary: Apple M4 Max (64 GB). gemma4-12b-mtp-assistant (Q4_K_XL target + Q8 drafter). Runtime: llama.cpp GGUF. Métricas: Base ~47.1-48.4 tok/s → 50.6 tok/s with 3 parallel streams (MTP); single-stream no gain. Uso: coding and general tasks on Apple Silicon with MTP speedup. Límite: MTP speedup only appears with multiple parallel streams; single-stream neutral. Por qué importa: Concrete before/after numbers + exact HF repo (sjakek/gemma4-12b-mtp-assistant) for builders wanting speculative decoding / MTP gains on M4 Max without custom code.
